attempt_families.direction: Make installation, runtime identity, phase boundaries, credit claims, reset windows, and referee isolation auditable.
attempt_families.observed_result: Keep the safety and measurement boundaries, but they do not reduce ordinary route cost and cannot establish subscription savings by themselves.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Revisit only for a concrete host, loader, meter, or release API change; keep new measurement machinery outside ordinary dispatch.

attempt_families.direction: Increase Luna coverage with fixed, dynamic, rolling, repair-first, and candidate-bound handoffs while retaining Sol overlap.
attempt_families.observed_result: Some runs showed coarse allowance signals, but quality misses, retained Sol replay, coordination, repair, and elapsed regressions prevented an equal-quality win.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Do not retry by merely adding workers, packages, overlap, routing scores, or handoff fields. A retry must remove measured Sol work or change the acceptance boundary.

attempt_families.direction: Bind Luna reasoning effort to external quality evidence and allow one Luna to own the complete implementation envelope.
attempt_families.observed_result: Complete Luna ownership produced a task-local 1-point versus 2-point five-hour signal and stronger quality, but it was 6 minutes 48 seconds slower and did not provide an equal-quality time win.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Keep lowest-supported effort and complete ownership. Do not make High a default; retry only with a bounded Medium-capable family and a cheaper Sol acceptance path.

attempt_families.direction: Separate route-external acceptance, bind candidate paths and receipts, compress handoffs, select effort, and assign validation ownership.
attempt_families.observed_result: The controls closed real evidence and ownership gaps, but P024 still used 3 displayed five-hour points versus 1 for Sol-only and took 1305.748 versus 861.129 seconds.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Retain the guards off the hot path. Do not add manifests, ledgers, hashes, or duplicated validation to ordinary success; a retry must delete measured controller or replay work.

attempt_families.direction: Remove duplicate acceptance checks and inherited-context replay, and permit a bounded Medium cold start.
attempt_families.observed_result: This identified Sol controller repetition as the dominant avoidable cost and removed several structural replays, but still lacked an equal-quality subscription-meter win. A later P123 changed-premise probe supplied fork_turns=1 yet did not expose the active parent-task marker to the model-overridden child.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Do not re-add controller polling, inherited context, repeated test bodies, or a second default full-suite run. Positive-count inheritance may be retried only with host evidence that the active task turn is exposed and auditable before child response; changing the count or wording is insufficient. New work must reduce an observed hot-path action.

attempt_families.direction: Use bounded dependency capsules, exception-triggered expansion, one retained Luna, compact installed profiles, and canonical receipts.
attempt_families.observed_result: Medium first-pass samples reached 32-45 seconds and about 5k-7k non-cached input, but compact text alone often increased rereads; High over-routing reached about 699 seconds and 119846 non-cached input.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Do not retry compact syntax, READ protocols, receipt fields, or global High as standalone levers. Retry only when the task capsule closes a previously observed semantic edge without another normal-path round.

attempt_families.direction: Slim ordinary Luna delivery, survive edit-safety refusals, add causal semantic refactor checks, and permit bounded multi-failure repair.
attempt_families.observed_result: Several arms cut diagnostic input or time but lost quality, were censored by edit safety, or broke the evidence return. Bounded same-Luna repair worked as a mechanism but did not establish allowance savings.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Do not trade acceptance coverage for fewer calls or cap repairs by failure count. Retry only with representative causal checks, absolute ownership, and one evidence-bearing return path.

attempt_families.direction: Require pre-suite contract coverage, immediate-parent receipts, one-turn preflight, and absolute formal-root path binding.
attempt_families.observed_result: The sequence fixed missing tests, wrong-parent evidence, extra preflight turns, and cross-workspace edits. P081 still failed both arms; P083 exposed self-authored tests being mistaken for independent authority.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Keep these correctness invariants. Do not repeat path, parent, or presence gates unless a new host failure violates them; the remaining target is economic substitution.

attempt_families.direction: Choose exactly one final suite executor from acceptance ownership and bind Sol review to the returned receipt.
attempt_families.observed_result: P085 matched 33 public and 12 hidden checks on both versions. v0.37.4 was 22.202% faster at the meter boundary, used 32.096% fewer combined non-cached input tokens, and halved full-suite executions, but both allowance changes stayed below one percentage point.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Retain the mechanism. Do not claim subscription savings until a frozen 20-30 minute task crosses the account meter; one pair cannot separate mechanism effect from first-pass candidate variance.

attempt_families.direction: Keep prior-attempt review outside normal dispatch, bind acceptance launches to one absolute workdir capsule, and distinguish delegated edit authority from a real host refusal.
attempt_families.observed_result: The release gate prevents unreviewed mechanism loops and the authority wording removed one false model-side refusal, but real host write denials remain fail-closed and cannot be repaired by prompt wording.
attempt_families.repeat_rule: Do not add normal-path manifests or confirmation prose. Revisit only for a concrete release-history omission, launch-boundary failure, or host authority API change.

release_entries.direction: Block a release until its proposed mechanisms are compared against every indexed prior attempt family.
release_entries.novelty_statement: Earlier releases guarded runtime economics and GitHub Latest, but none made prior-attempt review a pre-network release condition.

release_entries.direction: Bind ordinary acceptance execution to a canonical workdir, exact executable and arguments, and resolved environment values.
release_entries.observed_result: Relative environment and wrong-directory launches produced import failures; absolute formal-root execution also exposed semantic failures, so infrastructure evidence cannot justify escalation.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: An absolute formal root plus a textual acceptance command was assumed to preserve the worker's launch directory and relative environment resolution.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The existing acceptance field now names one canonical workdir, exact executable and arguments, and environment values resolved from that workdir without adding a tool or model round.
new_evidence: P103 relative fixture-only PYTHONPATH import failure
P104 relative two-entry PYTHONPATH launched from the tests directory

release_entries.direction: Distinguish an already user-authorized bounded parent package from a real tool or host edit refusal so Luna does not invent a second confirmation gate.
release_entries.observed_result: The old worker contract rejected an explicitly authorized disposable edit; the candidate contract completed the exact 18-byte edit once while preserving refusal and sandbox gates.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: The generic required-user-confirmation clause was assumed to distinguish missing authority from a genuine edit-safety refusal.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The candidate treats a user-authorized bounded parent package as sufficient edit authority, keeps real refusal fail-closed, and reduces the Skill to 1194 words and each writer profile to 184 words.
new_evidence: Old luna_worker_low rejected the explicitly authorized disposable probe
Candidate gpt-5.6-luna low wrote the exact 18-byte probe on its first attempt

release_entries.direction: Serialize setup mutations with one fail-fast operating-system advisory lock while leaving preview, migration-preview, and Doctor available.
release_entries.observed_result: A real duplicate-updater failure motivated the fix. The candidate passed 6 visible checks, 451 repository tests with 4 skips, 10 route-external hidden checks with 1 platform-permission skip, diff validation, and independent implementation review.
release_entries.novelty_statement: Earlier setup work made individual writes atomic but did not exclude concurrent install, update, migrate, or rollback operations across processes.

release_entries.direction: Replace repeated empty-queue Sol wakeups and global agent enumeration with one retained-worker completion wait.
release_entries.observed_result: On the P117 same-task ablation, full Sol-Luna credit equivalent fell from 8.063423 to 4.626947 and elapsed time from 335.215 to 300.868 seconds while public and hidden implementation quality remained equal. It stayed 24.457% slower than Sol-only.

milestone.reason: This was the first equal-quality matched route in the indexed history to clear the 50% credit-equivalent reduction target against Sol-only by removing controller wakeup work alone.
milestone.boundary: It did not clear the no-time-regression gate and did not measure the five-hour or weekly included-plan allowance.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: Removing inherited task context and duplicate acceptance was assumed to make an idle Sol controller passive while its retained Luna ran.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The controller now makes one long completion wait and never polls or enumerates unrelated agents on the ordinary empty-queue path, without adding a tool or model round.
new_evidence: P117 global agent enumeration exposed the matched arm summary

release_entries.direction: Require observed matched lower-effort quality evidence before a risk label can promote complete-Luna work to High or above.
release_entries.observed_result: On the same frozen P117 task, Luna Medium matched High at 19/19 public and 10/10 hidden checks with zero formal repair while the full route beat Sol-only time by 33.789% and credit equivalent by 29.340%; the earlier label-driven High route was 24.457% slower than Sol-only.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: Strict serialization and adversarial edge labels were assumed to be sufficient evidence that P117 required Luna High.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The ordinary rule now treats risk labels only as a higher quality bar and requires matched task-family evidence of a lower-effort quality or defect miss before High-or-above dispatch.
new_evidence: P117 Luna High equal-quality route remained 24.457% slower than Sol-only
P117 Luna Medium passed the same 19 public and 10 hidden checks in 160.060 seconds

follow_up_evidence.observed_result: On a new P124 task, Medium used 58.653% less credit equivalent than Sol-only but failed public quality 24/25 after one repair and was 16.841% slower. The evidence-authorized P125 High ablation recovered 25/25 public and 12/12 hidden quality and saved 65.116% credit equivalent, but was 56.357% slower than Sol-only.
follow_up_evidence.retry_gate: Do not retry another effort level or repair on P124/P125. A future unseen task may use High only after its own matched lower-effort quality evidence and must still pass the no-time-regression gate.

required_path_causal_follow_up.observed_result: P126's one-batch Medium route cleared diagnostic proxy and elapsed gates but failed 24/25 because a required path was omitted. P127 added the frozen required paths and structural acceptance label, passed 25/25 public and 12/12 hidden, used 69.282% less proxy credit, and was 8.941% faster than Sol-only; however, post-pass diff/status calls violated the installed Skill protocol.
required_path_causal_follow_up.retry_gate: Retire P124/P126/P127. Test a distinct unseen task with a complete required-path/acceptance-label capsule, all diff/status checks before the final suite, and any post-pass tool call treated as a censor.

release_entries.direction: Acquire already-known Skill, contract, dependency, acceptance, and test-list inputs in one bounded Sol action without removing information from the launch-ready capsule.
release_entries.observed_result: The P122 controller-only microbenchmark preserved the P121 pre-dispatch information and complete capsule while reducing proxy credit from 3.829540 to 2.181700 and elapsed time from 55.074 to 27.616 seconds. The later equal-quality P118 full-route ablation did not transfer: 4.913135 was only 41.478808% below Sol-only and 185.211 seconds was 19.004967% slower.

follow_up_decision.reason: The isolated controller-prefix win did not reduce complete-route accepted cost or elapsed time on P118.
follow_up_decision.retry_gate: Require a host or protocol change that reduces complete launch-capsule or controller-output cost without removing semantics, acceptance detail, exact execution identity, or quality.

release_entries.novelty_statement: Earlier work removed context, replay, polling, and redundant tests, but no indexed mechanism batched multiple already-known controller reads into one model round while preserving all inputs.

release_entries.direction: Align packaged skill-discovery metadata with the already verified implicit-discovery installation so managed updates cannot silently disable Sol-Luna discovery.
release_entries.observed_result: The installed metadata with implicit invocation enabled is discoverable in Codex, while the v0.38.1 managed-update preview rejected the repository's conflicting disabled source value instead of overwriting it.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: Source-bound managed installation was assumed to coexist safely with a locally enabled implicit-discovery policy that differed from the repository source.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The packaged source now matches the verified discoverable installed value, and a contract test prevents later releases from silently disabling implicit invocation.
new_evidence: Installed allow_implicit_invocation true exposes the sol-luna Skill
v0.38.1 setup preview reported agents/openai.yaml as a conflict against source false

release_entries.direction: Remove the ordinary-path batched-acquisition requirement after its isolated gain failed to transfer, and make the release gate review mechanisms from every prior release entry.
release_entries.observed_result: On P118, the batched v0.38.2 route preserved quality but cost 4.913135 credit equivalent and 185.211 seconds, versus 4.678860 and 155.579 seconds for v0.38.0. The original guarded preview then misclassified removal of the v0.38.1 mechanism because it indexed mechanism families but not prior release entries.

changed_premise.falsified_assumption: The isolated P122 batching gain was assumed to reduce the complete route, and the release gate was assumed to detect repeats of mechanisms introduced after the original family index.
changed_premise.measurable_difference: The Skill no longer requires one batched acquisition action, while the release-only guard now includes mechanisms from every earlier release entry and requires the candidate entry to be last.
new_evidence: P118 equal-quality v0.38.2 full-route cost increased 5.007096% and elapsed increased 19.046272% versus v0.38.0
The first v0.38.3 guarded preview rejected an explicit batching retry as a non-overlapping new direction

unseen_transfer_evidence.observed_result: On the distinct frozen P128 capacity-reservation task, v0.38.3 Sol-Luna and Sol-only both passed 49/49 public and 12/12 hidden checks. Sol-Luna used 5.078984 versus 13.906900 full-session credit equivalent (63.478676% lower) and 186.875 versus 329.289 seconds (43.248939% faster), with one Luna Medium writer, zero repair, zero Sol implementation/replay/reclaim, and strict final-suite-last conformance.
unseen_transfer_evidence.retry_gate: Retire P128. Do not tune its paths, labels, checks, effort, or repair policy. Expand the claim only on another independently frozen task family or a sufficiently resolved account meter, without adding ordinary-path reporting burden.
